title: DeepKnown-Guard: A Proprietary Model-Based Safety Response Framework for AI Agents
authors: Qi Li; Jianjun Xu; Pingtao Wei; Jiu Li; Peiqiang Zhao; Jiwei Shi; Xuan Zhang; Yanhui Yang; Xiaodong Hui; Peng Xu; Wenqin Shao
why_relevant: Proposes a safety framework combining input classification and RAG-based grounded generation, touching on hallucination reduction via traceable retrieval.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on safety/value alignment for LLM agents rather than robustness of RAG under noisy, conflicting, or adversarial evidence; engineering-oriented with limited methodological contribution to the survey themes.
